content_sections.heading: KGMU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the KGMU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download KGMU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KGMU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by King George's Medical University (KGMU), located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, for filling various senior resident positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available in KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies available for the Senior Resident (Un-reg.) posts across Critical Care Medicine and Medical Oncology departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to submit their applications and attend the interview directly as per schedule.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for KGMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D., M.S., or DNB degree recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or National Medical Commission (NMC).

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form to the designated office is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the shortlisted or eligible candidates will be conducted on 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years as per the existing NMC rules.

faq.question: Q8. How much is the application fee for UR and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved (UR) and OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 3,000/- for the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I check the official website of KGMU?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of King George's Medical University at www.kgmcindia.edu for all official updates and notifications.

faq.question: Q10. What are the selection criteria for this walk-in drive?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a walk-in-interview accompanied by a thorough verification of all original educational and identity documents.
